title: Patch: the reply's countdown blend is screened and set where the screen keeps it
thread:
**Issue #4286 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #4286: Patch: the reply's countdown blend is screened and set where the screen keeps it
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

When the practice opponent weighs its options on a turn where a delayed effect is still ticking down (the public "in N turns" badges), it scores each option twice: once as the board stands, and once with every countdown fired at its next turn start. It then blends the two scores with a fixed guess of half weight per turn waited. That guess was never measured. It was a starting value left for the training program to tune, and the training program no longer runs. Once built, the computer's valuation of every line that leaves a countdown ticking rests on a measured number instead of a guess. Players notice it as a practice opponent that handles countdown cards more sensibly, neither throwing away setup plays nor overpaying for futures that never arrive.

## Why

- `AI_REPLY.countdown_share` is `0.5` in `crates/ai/src/config.rs`, commented `#1995: untuned; the training lanes may move it`.
- `training/README.md`: the `improve` and `unban` lanes are stopped (#1677) and the `learn` lane is retired (#4159, R4159000). No lane remains to move it, so the guess sits forever unless an ordinary issue screens it.
- The blend steers real decisions: `crates/ai/src/reply.rs` (`countdowns_due`, R1181000) scores every line with a waiting countdown a second time, fired, and blends at `share^wait`, so a wrong share systematically misevaluates all such lines.
- Nothing open or rejected covers it: #4246 is the reply's other blend switch (`open_lethal`), #4257 is the Cleave splash beside a GIGA, and the rejected list holds no countdown item.

## Proposal

- Screen candidate values (`0`, `0.25`, `0.5`, `0.75`, `1.0`) with `cargo jackioh arena --a self --b bin:<control> --set improve-dev`, following `training/improve.md` ("A screen"): 400 paired games per screen, control built from the committed tip.
- Set `countdown_share` to the screened winner when its edge over the `0.5` control holds up (paired edge interval clear of zero); otherwise keep `0.5` and record the screen in the constant's comment.
- Rewrite the constant's comment to name the screen (games, edge, interval) instead of "untuned".
- No ruling note: this tunes a named constant, not a rules decision, so the spec is unchanged.

## Where it lands

- `crates/ai/src/config.rs` (`AI_REPLY.countdown_share`); SPEC §9.9 (practice AI) and R1181000 (countdown badges).
- `crates/ai/src/reply.rs` stays as it is (the blend arithmetic is unchanged); the screen method lives in `training/improve.md` ("A screen") and `crates/tools/src/arena.rs` (`--set improve-dev`).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Screen table posted: each candidate's wins, paired edge and 95% interval against the `0.5` control on `improve-dev`.
- [ ] `countdown_share` set to the screened value with the screen named in its comment, or kept at `0.5` with the no-keep screen recorded there.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-ai` green, countdown tests (`tests/ai/slumber.rs`, `tests/ai/meditative_plus.rs`) included.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh gate` smoke green.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean.

## Size and risks

- Medium work, `difficulty:hard` (the AI, per `docs/issues-and-patches.md`), `priority:low` (class `ai`). One constant plus screens of about 30 to 45 minutes each; run candidates in order and stop early on a clear winner.
- Risk: screen noise picks a false winner. Mitigated by paired deals and by requiring the interval to clear zero, else `0.5` stays.
- Risk: none to the rules. Value change only; countdown logic and every signature are untouched.

---

## Plan

_Written by `claude-4` (claude, `opus`, strong) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/44694331872)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Screen `AI_REPLY.countdown_share`, the untuned `0.5` in `crates/ai/src/config.rs`, at `0`, `0.25`, `0.75` and `1.0`. `reply_score` blends a countdown's fired score in at `share^wait`. Each arm gets a 400-game paired screen on `improve-dev` against a `0.5` control built from the base, as `training/improve.md` ("A screen") describes. Keep the first arm, in that order, whose `edgeLow` is above 0. If none clears zero, keep `0.5`. Either way, replace the "untuned" comment with one that names the screens (games, wins, edge, interval, control SHA), and put the screen table in `.bot-notes.md` and in the report's body. `crates/ai/src/reply.rs`, the spec and the rulings stay as they are: this tunes a named constant, so it needs no ruling.

## Files to touch

| Path | New / change | What changes there |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/ai/src/config.rs` | change | `AI_REPLY` only: the `countdown_share` value (line 1025) and its comment (line 1024) |

Must not touch: `crates/ai/src/reply.rs` (the blend arithmetic), any other file in `crates/ai/`, the other crates, `apps/`, `e2e/`, `luau/`, `spec/`, `spec/rulings/`, `spec/pending/`, `crates/cards/patches/pending/` (an AI-only change claims no card), the docs (`crates/ai/README.md:109`, `docs/polish/3-ai.md:756` and §9.9 name no value), `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, `.claude/`. Governing: SPEC §9.9 (Evaluation: a countdown is blended in by `AI_REPLY.countdown_share`), R1181000 (the countdown badges the reply reads), `training/improve.md` ("A screen", "How much a result says").

## Steps

Where these steps depart from the earlier plan, the code showed it wrong:
- The base is `ae977ece3e`, not `d70de4be`.
- `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` is set (`/home/runner/work/JackiOh/JackiOh/target`), so the binary is not at `target/release/jackioh`.
- The harness commits the worktree as it stands when a run stops, so a candidate value must never sit in the file during a screen.
- The arena prints 400 records unless given `--out`.
- A screen outlasts the Bash tool's 10-minute foreground cap.
- The stop rule follows the issue ("stop early on a clear winner"), not "largest edge".

Measured on this 4-core box: the release build of `jackioh-tools` took 176 s from a warm cache. A 16-game paired arena run took 45 s, so a 400-game screen takes about 20–30 minutes. Run every command that can pass 10 minutes with Bash `run_in_background: true` and `timeout: 7200000`, and wait for its completion notification. Never `sleep`-poll.

1. **Resume.** Read `## Screens` in `.bot-notes.md`, if a run before you wrote one. Never run an arm it already records (improve.md: never screen the same change again). If an arm there reads `kept`, go to step 6.
2. **Base.** `git status --porcelain` must print nothing. Then run `SHA=$(git rev-parse --short=10 HEAD); echo $SHA` (expect `ae977ece3e`). Add to `.bot-notes.md`: `## Screens` (if it is missing), a line `control: countdown_share 0.5 at <SHA>, 400 games each on improve-dev`, then the header row `| share | W-L | draws | aborted | edge | edgeLow | edgeHigh | outcome |`.
3. **Control.** `cargo build --release -p jackioh-tools && cp "${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-target}/release/jackioh" "$HOME/control-jackioh"`.
4. **Candidate binaries, one at a time, before any screen.** For each `<v>` in `0.0`, `0.25`, `0.75`, `1.0` (skip the ones already recorded):
   a. Edit `crates/ai/src/config.rs` line 1025 from `    countdown_share: 0.5,` to `    countdown_share: <v>,`. Change only the value.
   b. Run `cargo test -p jackioh-ai 2>&1 | grep -E '^test result:|FAILED|panicked|^error' | tail -30`. If any test fails, the arm is out: a test pins a ranking or a puzzle outcome (config.rs header), and editing it would weaken it. Add the row `| <v> | – | – | – | – | – | – | not screened: fails <test names> |` and skip c.
   c. `cargo build --release -p jackioh-tools && cp "${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-target}/release/jackioh" "$HOME/cand-<v>-jackioh"`.
   d. Edit line 1025 back to `    countdown_share: 0.5,`. Then `git status --porcelain` must print nothing before you go on.
5. **Screens, in the order `0.0`, `0.25`, `0.75`, `1.0`**, for each arm that has a binary. Run in the background:
   ```sh
   "$HOME/cand-<v>-jackioh" arena --a self --b "bin:$HOME/control-jackioh" --set improve-dev --out "/tmp/cs-<v>" > "/tmp/cs-<v>.log" 2>&1; echo "exit $?"; tail -n 2 "/tmp/cs-<v>.log"
   ```
   The arena prints only after all 400 games. The second-to-last line is the tally JSON, where `a` is the candidate: `aWins`, `bWins`, `draws`, `aborted`, `deals` (must be 200), `edge`, `edgeLow`, `edgeHigh`. If the exit is non-zero or there is no tally, read `tail -n 20` of the log, fix the cause and run that arm again. That is not a re-read, since it produced no result.
   As soon as each tally lands, append its row to `## Screens` with the numbers exactly as printed: `| <v> | <aWins>-<bWins> | <draws> | <aborted> | <edge> | <edgeLow> | <edgeHigh> | kept / not kept |`.
   - If `edgeLow` is above 0, that arm is kept. Stop: add `| <v'> | not run: <v> kept |` for each arm after it.
   - Otherwise it is not kept. Go on to the next arm.
   - Never extend a screen, re-run one, or pass `--games` after seeing a result.
   - A read of `edge 0.0 (0.0 to 0.0)` means the arm changed no game on these deals: not kept.
6. **Decide.** The value is the kept arm. If no arm is kept, it stays `0.5`.
7. **Apply** in `crates/ai/src/config.rs`.
   - Set line 1025 to the value as a Rust literal (`0.0`, `0.25`, `0.75`, `1.0` or `0.5`).
   - Replace line 1024, `    // #1995: untuned; the training lanes may move it.`, with the template below that fits.
   - Indent 4 spaces, prefix `// `, and wrap at 110 columns, as the `open_lethal` comment above it does.
   - Numbers are copied from the tallies. Arms are named `0`, `0.25`, `0.75`, `1.0` in prose.
   - Add `with <d> drawn` / `<a> aborted` after an arm's W-L when they are non-zero.
   - Leave the field doc at lines 1002–1004 alone (it names no value).
   - Kept arm:
     ```
     // #1995: <v>, kept by #4286's screen (training/improve.md, A screen): 400 games on improve-dev
     // against the 0.5 control at <SHA>, <W>-<L>, edge <edge> (<edgeLow> to <edgeHigh>). <earlier>
     ```
     `<earlier>` is empty when it was the first arm. Otherwise write `Before it, <v'> read <W>-<L>, edge <e> (<lo> to <hi>), which kept nothing`, one clause per earlier arm joined by `;`, and for an arm out at step 4b, `<v'> failed <test> and was not screened`. End it with `.`.
   - None kept:
     ```
     // #1995: 0.5. #4286's screens (training/improve.md, A screen), each 400 games on improve-dev against
     // the 0.5 control at <SHA>, kept no other value: 0 read <W>-<L>, edge <e> (<lo> to <hi>); 0.25 read
     // …; 0.75 read …; 1.0 read ….
     ```
8. **Verify**, with the commands under Tests. If a test, the workspace suite or the gate fails only at the new value, do not touch the test. Set `0.5` back and use the none-kept template, adding `; <v> cleared its screen but failed <test>, so 0.5 stays`. Record it in the notes.
9. **Report.** Copy the `## Screens` table, the control SHA, the arena command and the decision into the report's body. List every decision the task left open, with the alternative rejected:
   - the stop at the first clear arm, not the largest edge;
   - a test-failing arm not screened;
   - the order of the arms;
   - the comment wording.

## Tests

No new test. `crates/ai/src/config.rs`'s header says tests pin rankings and puzzle outcomes, never these values. The blend itself is pinned by `the_ais_own_countdown_is_blended_in_at_its_share_per_turn_it_still_waits` (`crates/ai/tests/ai/meditative_plus.rs:574`), which reads `AI_REPLY.countdown_share` and so holds at any value. These countdown tests must be green at the final value:
- `crates/ai/tests/ai/meditative_plus.rs`:
  - `the_ai_casts_supply_drop_in_combat_mode_against_three_3_health_units` (Supply Drop waits two turns past the next, so it counts at `share²`; low arms may fail it)
  - `an_enemy_countdown_scores_a_3_health_unit_on_the_field_below_one_held`
  - `r3696000_r4159000_beside_two_castable_vanillas_the_hand_eval_plays_a_vanilla_first`
  - `r3696000_on_a_tight_budget_the_supply_drop_line_costs_no_world_its_score`
  - `r3696000_past_the_wrap_up_the_supply_drop_line_is_not_replied_to`
  - the blend test above
- `crates/ai/tests/ai/slumber.rs`: the `r2380000_…` tests (Dormant countdowns; `slumber_turn_share`, which this leaves alone).

Commands, after step 7:
1. `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai meditative_plus` and `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai slumber`
2. `cargo test -p jackioh-ai 2>&1 | grep -E '^test result:|FAILED|panicked' | tail -30`
3. Only when the value changed, in the background: `cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts 2>&1 | grep -E '^test result:|FAILED|panicked|^error' | tail -40`. The AI decides games in the server's, shared's, run's and tools' tests too.
4. `cargo jackioh gate 2>&1 | tail -20`, in the background (smoke size: 20 games per matchup). It must pass.
5. `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy -p jackioh-ai --all-targets -- -D warnings`
6. `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims`: expect kind AI or Internal and no claim failure.
7. `git status --porcelain`: only `crates/ai/src/config.rs`.

## Done when

- [ ] `## Screens` in `.bot-notes.md` and the report's body: each of `0`, `0.25`, `0.75`, `1.0` with W-L, draws, aborted, edge and its 95% interval against the `0.5` control at the named SHA, or why it was not screened or not run.
- [ ] `countdown_share` is the kept arm, or `0.5` with the screens recorded. Its comment names games, W-L, edge and interval, and no longer says "untuned".
- [ ] `config.rs` holds `0.5` at every moment a screen ran or the run could stop with no decision made.
- [ ] The Tests commands green (the workspace suite when the value changed), with the gate smoke, rustfmt, clippy and classify.
- [ ] `reply.rs`, the spec, the rulings and every other file untouched. No new ruling, test or fragment.

## Risks

- **A cut-off run delivers a candidate value.** The harness commits the worktree when the run stops, so step 4d restores `0.5` before any screen, and each tally goes into `.bot-notes.md` as it lands. A continuing run rebuilds the binaries (`$HOME` does not carry over) and runs only the unrecorded arms.
- **Noise picks a false winner.** Each kept arm needs its own `edgeLow` above 0 on paired deals, and the run stops at the first arm that clears. Four arms at a one-sided 2.5% each give about a 10% chance of a false keep at worst, the issue's accepted method. Never re-run or extend an arm for a better read.
- **Time.** About 4 × (25 + 6) minutes against the job's 330-minute budget. It fits, and the stop rule usually shortens it.
- **Determinism, replay, hidden information, purity.** This is a value change only. Arena games are a function of seed and agents. The reply reads only public badges (R1181000, R185). No wire, TypeScript or WASM type carries `AI_REPLY` (no `countdownShare` anywhere outside the crate). The hotseat golden replay has no AI in it.
- **The binary's path.** `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` is set on these boxes, so always copy from `${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-target}/release/jackioh`. Give the control as `bin:$HOME/…` (the arena also expands `bin:~/`).

## Open questions

None for a person.
````
